contexts.text: With my son, and with my grandson () = concerning the things which are of faith.
Good from truths produces other truths... which are the sons' sons or grandsons.
Their sons, and grandsons, who are here named, are nothing but derivations.
He who loves himself, loves his own, who are in special his children and grandchildren.
The father returns in effigy, if not in his sons, still in his grandsons, and great-grandsons.
